8.news: Thomas, welcome to South London. Welcome back to the Premier League. What makes Thomas Frank a good fit for Crystal Palace? And what makes Crystal Palace a good fit for Thomas Frank?
8.quote: hmm, this could be a good fit.
8.title: Every word from Thomas Frank's first Palace press conference

summary: Chelsea: Alonso not expecting anyone back, Caicedo fit
Leeds United: Everyone fit, Farke on Stach
Brentford: Thiago still banned, four still injured, Milambo + Dasilva building fitness
Coventry City: Awoniyi out, Wright not ready to return, Yirenkyi + Mason-Clark could be available
Arsenal: Arteta unsure whether Raya will be fit but goalkeeper does train, Saliba to get mins this week
Manchester United: Fernandes to be assessed after virus, Baleba out, Rashford on the grass
Liverpool: Gakpo out, Gravenberch doubtful, Munoz not seriously injured
Manchester City: Semenyo close to returning. no new concerns
Brighton and Hove Albion: Mitoma still 1-2 weeks away, Gomez rested, Boscagli should return
Bournemouth: Kroupi misses win over Celta Vigo due to illness, Gannon-Doak also sick
Tottenham Hotspur: Savio out till after Xmas, Bergvall ill, Tosin + Mudryk still out
Aston Villa: Cash back from concussion, Onana + Ruggeri still out
Everton: Tarkowski suspended, Moyes coy on injury news
Newcastle United: Joelinton out, Hall trains, Jaissle to assess if Livramento can start
Crystal Palace: Mateta + Pino suspended, Sarr still out, no fresh fitness issues
Sunderland: Black Cats have illness issues, five still injured, loanee Danso can’t play
Fulham: Smith Rowe + Andersen ruled out
Ipswich Town: Davis fit and will start
Hull City: Iroegbunam joins injury list, Ansah back in training
